name: Stroke Text
description: Large SVG headline that draws its letter outlines stroke by stroke, then fills them with a wipe or fade, with optional dashed outlines, drop shadow and several triggers.
contents: SVG text rendered as an outline layer and a fill layer, split per character
Optional dashed or dotted outline masked to the letter edges
Optional soft drop shadow that lifts in after the fill
behavior: Outline draws letter by letter with a stagger via GSAP stroke dash offset
Fill follows by a directional clip wipe or per-letter fade
Trigger can be mount, scroll (top 82% of viewport, once), hover (pointer enter) or loop (yoyo with 0.9s pause)
Optional hover redraw replays the outline after the first draw finishes
Optional marching dashes animate continuously for dashed or dotted styles
Scales to container width through the SVG viewBox, measured with getBBox and ResizeObserver
With prefers-reduced-motion the final state is shown with no animation
editableByProps: Text, font size, weight, family and letter spacing
Stroke and fill colors, stroke width, solid, dashed or dotted outline, marching dashes
Draw duration, fill delay, stagger, easing, reverse order
Trigger type, fill mode, wipe direction, hover redraw
Drop shadow on or off and its color

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the scroll trigger start position

needsCodeEdit.where: SHADOW_OPACITY constant and the lift/softness values

needsCodeEdit.change: Change loop pause or fill wipe easing
needsCodeEdit.where: build function inside the animation useLayoutEffect

needsCodeEdit.change: Change dot or dash spacing logic

fixed: Requires gsap and its ScrollTrigger plugin, registered at module load
Fills the full width of its parent as a block, with the SVG capped at the measured text width
Text is a single line, no wrapping, so long text shrinks to fit the container width
Uses Tailwind utility classes for layout (block, w-full, mx-auto, select-none, cursor-pointer)
Shadow has no effect when fillMode is none
Hover trigger shows the final state first and redraws on pointer enter, so it does not work on touch devices
Marching only applies to dashed and dotted styles
Hidden until text is measured, so it appears after the first layout pass
